description: Report the running MCP server version and update status. Use when the user asks which Poindeo MCP version they have or whether an update is available. Side-effect free — it does not open the editor tab, so prefer it over reading plugin manifests (a stale manifest version is not the running version). Checking also downloads the new version in the background if one is found (idempotent). Reply to the user with just the one-line version string this tool returns — no extra details.
name: poindeo_version
